For each billed line in applies_to.array whose code matches a broad structural code_regex (e.g. '^[A-Z]\d{4}$' for HCPCS Level II), look up the code's MUE record in the validator's reference tables. If the lookup fails or returns no mue_value, do nothing (never guess). If mue_value == 0 — optionally further gated on an mai_values list (e.g. ['2','3']) matching the record's adjudication indicator — the code is payable at zero units per date of service under the payer's own policy, so the line is removed from the billed array (or moved to a non-billed review bucket with needs_review=True, per an action.disposition switch) and exactly one issue is emitted per suppressed line with placeholders {code} {desc} {mue_value} {mai} {rationale} quoting the MUE record's own rationale text. Single-axis guarantees: only presence of the matched lines is written; units, modifiers, other lines, ICD lines, and coding_result are untouched; nothing is ever added. Conservatism: unparseable code_regex, missing MUE record, mue_value > 0, or an MAI outside the configured gate => no action. Determinism: lines processed in claim order; the suppression decision depends only on the reference MUE table, never on note text or code identity in the rule.
